Hark! the wailing of the shepherds, For their glory is spoiled; Hark! the roaring of young lions, For the thickets of the Jordan are spoiled. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-default"
Thus said the Lord my God: 'Feed the flock of slaughter; <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-default"

whose buyers slay them, and hold themselves not guilty; and they that sell them say: Blessed be the Lord , for I am rich; and their own shepherds pity them not. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-default"

For I will no more pity the inhabitants of the land, saith the Lord ; but, lo, I will deliver the men every one into his neighbour's hand, and into the hand of his king; and they shall smite the land, and out of their hand I will not deliver them.' <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-default"

So I fed the flock of slaughter, verily the poor of the flock. And I took unto me two staves; the one I called Graciousness, and the other I called Binders; and I fed the flock. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-default"
And I cut off the three shepherds in one month; 'for My soul became impatient of them, and their soul also loathed Me.' <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-default"

Then said I: 'I will not feed you; that which dieth, let it die; and that which is to be cut off, let it be cut off; and let them that are left eat every one the flesh of another.' <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-default"
And I took my staff Graciousness, and cut it asunder, 'that I might break My covenant which I had made with all the peoples.' <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-default"
And it was broken in that day; and the poor of the flock that gave heed unto me knew of a truth that it was the word of the Lord .  ​ <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-default"
And I said unto them: 'If ye think good, give me my hire; and if not, forbear.' So they weighed for my hire thirty pieces of silver. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-default"

And the Lord said unto me: 'Cast it into the treasury, the goodly price that I was prized at of them.' And I took the thirty pieces of silver, and cast them into the treasury, in the house of the Lord . <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-default"
Then I cut asunder mine other staff, even Binders, that the brotherhood between Judah and Israel might be broken. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-default"
And the Lord said unto me : 'Take unto thee yet the instruments of a foolish shepherd. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-default"

For, lo, I will raise up a shepherd in the land, who will not think of those that are cut off, neither will seek those that are young, nor heal that which is broken; neither will he feed that which standeth still, but he will eat the flesh of the fat, and will break their hoofs in pieces.' <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

Woe to the worthless shepherd That leaveth the flock! The sword shall be upon his arm, And upon his right eye; His arm shall be clean dried up, And his right eye shall be utterly darkened. <span class="anchor"
12: 12 The burden of the word of the Lord concerning Israel. The saying of the Lord , who stretched forth the heavens, And laid the foundation of the earth, And formed the spirit of man within him. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Behold, I will make Jerusalem a cup of staggering Unto all the peoples round about, And upon Judah also shall it fall to be in the siege against Jerusalem. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-default"

And it shall come to pass in that day, That I will make Jerusalem a stone of burden for all the peoples; All that burden themselves with it shall be sore wounded; And all the nations of the earth shall be gathered together against it. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

In that day, saith the Lord , I will smite every horse with bewilderment, And his rider with madness; And I will open Mine eyes upon the house of Judah, And will smite every horse of the peoples with blindness. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
And the chiefs of Judah shall say in their heart: 'The inhabitants of Jerusalem are my strength Through the Lord of hosts their God.' <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

In that day will I make the chiefs of Judah Like a pan of fire among wood, And like a torch of fire among sheaves; And they shall devour all the peoples round about, On the right hand and on the left; And Jerusalem shall be inhabited again in her own place, even in Jerusalem. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

The Lord also shall save the tents of Judah first, That the glory of the house of David And the glory of the inhabitants of Jerusalem be not magnified above Judah. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

In that day shall the Lord defend the inhabitants of Jerusalem; And he that stumbleth among them at that day shall be as David, And the house of David shall be as a godlike being, As the angel of the Lord before them.  ​ <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
And it shall come to pass in that day, That I will seek to destroy all the nations That come against Jerusalem. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

And I will pour upon the house of David, And upon the inhabitants of Jerusalem, The spirit of grace and of supplication; And they shall look unto Me because they have thrust him through; And they shall mourn for him, as one mourneth for his only son, And shall be in bitterness for him, as one that is in bitterness for his first-born. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
In that day shall there be a great mourning in Jerusalem, As the mourning of Hadadrimmon in the valley of Megiddon. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

And the land shall mourn, every family apart: The family of the house of David apart, and their wives apart; The family of the house of Nathan apart, and their wives apart; <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
The family of the house of Levi apart, and their wives apart; The family of the Shimeites apart, and their wives apart; <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
All the families that remain, Every family apart, and their wives apart. <span class="anchor"
13: 13 In that day there shall be a fountain opened To the house of David and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, For purification and for sprinkling. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

And it shall come to pass in that day, Saith the Lord of hosts, That I will cut off the names of the idols out of the land, And they shall no more be remembered; And also I will cause the prophets And the unclean spirit to pass out of the land. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-default"

And it shall come to pass that, when any shall yet prophesy, then his father and his mother that begot him shall say unto him: 'Thou shalt not live, for thou speakest lies in the name of the Lord '; and his father and his mother that begot him shall thrust him through when he prophesieth. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-default"

And it shall come to pass in that day, that the prophets shall be brought to shame every one through his vision, when he prophesieth; neither shall they wear a hairy mantle to deceive; <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-default"
but he shall say: 'I am no prophet, I am a tiller of the ground; for I have been made a bondman from my youth.' <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-default"
And one shall say unto him: 'What are these wounds between thy hands?' Then he shall answer: 'Those with which I was wounded in the house of my friends.' <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

Awake, O sword, against My shepherd, And against the man that is near unto Me, Saith the Lord of hosts; Smite the shepherd, and the sheep shall be scattered; And I will turn My hand upon the little ones. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
And it shall come to pass, that in all the land, saith the Lord , Two parts therein shall be cut off and die; But the third shall be left therein. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

And I will bring the third part through the fire, And will refine them as silver is refined, And will try them as gold is tried; They shall call on My name, And I will answer them; I will say: 'It is My people',  ​ And they shall say. 'The Lord is my God.' <span class="anchor"
14: 14 Behold, a day of the Lord cometh, When thy spoil shall be divided in the midst of thee. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

For I will gather all nations against Jerusalem to battle; And the city shall be taken, and the houses rifled, And the women ravished, And half of the city shall go forth into captivity, But the residue of the people shall not be cut off from the city. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Then shall the Lord go forth, And fight against those nations, As when He fighteth in the day of battle. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

And His feet shall stand in that day upon the mount of Olives, Which is before Jerusalem on the east, And the mount of Olives shall be cleft in the midst thereof Toward the east and toward the west, So that there shall be a very great valley; And half of the mountain shall remove toward the north, And half of it toward the south. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

And ye shall flee to the valley of the mountains; For the valley of the mountains shall reach unto Azel; Yea, ye shall flee, like as ye fled from before the earthquake In the days of Uzziah king of Judah; And the Lord my God shall come, And all the holy ones with Thee. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
And it shall come to pass in that day, that there shall not be light, But heavy clouds and thick; <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
And there shall be one day Which shall be known as the Lord's , Not day, and not night; But it shall come to pass, that at evening time there shall be light. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

And it shall come-to pass in that day, That living waters shall go out from Jerusalem: Half of them, toward the eastern sea, And half of them toward the western sea; In summer and in winter shall it be. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
And the Lord shall be King over all the earth; In that day shall the Lord be One, and His name one. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-default"

All the land shall be turned as the Arabah, from Geba to Rimmon south of Jerusalem; and she shall be lifted up, and inhabited in her place, from Benjamin's gate unto the place of the first gate, unto the corner gate, and from the tower of Hananel unto the king's winepresses. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
And men shall dwell therein, And there shall be no more extermination; But Jerusalem shall dwell safely. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

And this shall be the plague wherewith the Lord will smite All the peoples that have warred against Jerusalem: Their flesh shall consume away while they stand upon their feet, And their eyes shall consume away in their sockets, And their tongue shall consume away in their mouth. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

And it shall come to pass in that day, That a great tumult from the Lord shall be among them; And they shall lay hold every one on the hand of his neighbour, And his hand shall rise up against the hand of his neighbour. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

And Judah also shall fight against Jerusalem;  ​ And the wealth of all the nations round about shall be gathered together, Gold, and silver, and apparel, in great abundance. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
And so shall be the plague of the horse, Of the mule, of the camel, and of the ass, And of all the beasts that shall be in those camps, as this plague. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-default"

And it shall come to pass, that every one that is left of all the nations that came against Jerusalem shall go up from year to year to worship the King, the Lord of hosts, and to keep the feast of tabernacles. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-default"

And it shall be, that whoso of the families of the earth goeth not up unto Jerusalem to worship the King, the Lord of hosts, upon them there shall be no rain. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-default"

And if the family of Egypt go not up, and come not, they shall have no overflow; there shall be the plague, wherewith the Lord will smite the nations that go not up to keep the feast of tabernacles. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-default"
This shall be the punishment of Egypt, and the punishment of all the nations that go not up to keep the feast of tabernacles. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-default"
In that day shall there be upon the bells of the horses: HOLY UNTO THE LORD ; and the pots in the Lord's house shall be like the basins before the altar. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-default"

Yea, every pot in Jerusalem and in Judah shall be holy unto the Lord of hosts; and all they that sacrifice shall come and take of them, and seethe therein; and in that day there shall be no more a trafficker in the house of the Lord of hosts.   ↑ That is, the nations. See verse 9 .
